content: Root cause: The bug was caused by improper state tracking in the handling of component open/close operations within the ASoC (ALSA System on Chip) framework. Specifically, the logic introduced in a previous commit assumed that `snd_soc_component_open` and `snd_soc_component_close` would be called only once per component, which is incorrect as these functions can be invoked independently for each component-substream pair. This led to errors during PCM playback and module unloading when one or more components failed to open, as the previously opened components were not properly closed, resulting in resource leaks and inconsistent states. The patch corrects this by implementing error handling that ensures all successfully opened components are closed if any subsequent component fails to open.
